title: Three Polaroids
objective: Bring your Polaroid camera and take three permitted photos: a place, a detail, and a memory together. Swap if you do not have the camera or film.

title: Three discoveries
objective: Photograph three details you would normally walk past. Take photographs only where permitted.

title: The free adventure
objective: See how much you can explore without spending anything (parking excluded).

title: Pack a picnic
objective: Bring a picnic and enjoy it in a designated picnic area.

title: A chapter away
objective: Spend twenty minutes reading together in a suitable public seating area.

title: The unfamiliar path
objective: Choose a marked public path you have not explored together.

title: Nature’s details
objective: Spot three different birds, plants, or natural textures. Observe without collecting.

title: Two surprising facts
objective: Each discover one surprising fact and share it with the other.

title: The unexpected order
objective: Order one thing you would not normally choose, within your budget.

title: The $30 adventure
objective: See how much fun you can have within $30 total, including tax and tips; stop before the cap.

title: Secret selections
objective: Each choose a small surprise for the other within a shared spending cap.

title: The unusual find
objective: Each find the strangest item you would actually consider owning. Buying is optional.

title: Rock-paper-scissors dinner
objective: Play to decide who chooses each course you already planned to buy. Stay within your budget.

title: Favorite-things hunt
objective: Choose a favorite drink, snack, useful item, or activity for each other within an agreed cap.

title: Look up
objective: Find three architectural details and choose your favorite.

title: Your partner’s pick
objective: Let your companion choose the next public stop or detail to investigate.

title: An hour away
objective: Spend an hour exploring without recreational screen use; navigation is allowed.

title: Hammock pause
objective: Bring your tree-hung hammocks and relax together where the land manager permits it. Use suitable healthy trees and tree-friendly straps; check the posted rules and actual trees. Swap if the spot is unsuitable.

title: The encore conversation
objective: After the performance, each share your favorite moment with the other.

title: The $10 mini-adventure
objective: Find something fun to do for $10 total or less, including tax and tips. Stop before the cap; spending less is welcome.
